## How to Slick Back Hair: Tips from a Pro?


Slicked-back hair is a timeless look that demands healthy, well-prepped hair to achieve lasting hold and shine. Follow these pro tips on how to slick back hair so you can ooze confidence and elegance wherever you go—from work to weekend.

This moisturizing leave-in instantly hydrates, softens, and detangles, providing 12x more moisture after one use.* ****


## Work on Damp Hair


In order for products to glide on and distribute evenly, gently towel dry the hair after showering. You want the hair toweled enough so that it’s not dripping but is still wet enough to dampen a paper towel if it were to touch your hair.

**Pro tip:** Just like when you’re detangling your hair, start from the ends, working your way up so as to not cause any damage to the hair via styling mechanically.


## Find the Right Product


Regardless of which product you choose to


slick back your hair,


it should be one that provides ample hold and shine. The specific product and brand will come down to trial and error. Choose what works best for your

## Work in Product


Whether using OLAPLEX stylers (or any gel, mousse, or pomade), use your hands to work the product through your combed back hair. Once the product is evenly distributed, use the wide-toothed comb to set your slicked back style in place.
